verdict.rationale: Paperspace serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at https://api.paperspace.com/v1/openapi.json with 61 paths, and its DigitalOcean-hosted API reference is generated from that spec. That directly lets an AI-native user download the spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness, and documentation that points users to the spec URL (the unversioned path returns 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The production API domain serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /v1/openapi.json
The DigitalOcean-hosted Paperspace API reference is generated from it.
